options.name: Thunder Hawk

shared_context: The youth football club needs to select a mascot that appeals to children aged 8-12 and can be easily represented on merchandise and uniforms. The mascot should reflect the team's spirit and be suitable for community events.

personas.name: Maya
personas.background: Maya is a youth sports coach passionate about energizing young players.
personas.private_goal: To select a mascot that inspires team spirit and is visually striking on merchandise.

A.reason_for: Strong and dynamic image that can energize the team and fans, with high merchandise compatibility.

B.reason_for: Represents strength and resilience, popular locally.
B.reason_against: Costume may be bulky and merchandise compatibility is only moderate.

C.reason_for: Appeals to younger children with an agile and clever image.
C.reason_against: Low community recognition and requires more promotion.

D.reason_for: Symbolizes teamwork and determination, fitting for football.
D.reason_against: Moderate merchandise compatibility and color scheme visibility concerns.

personas.name: Liam
personas.background: Liam is a local sports culture enthusiast and parent of a club player.
personas.private_goal: To ensure the mascot is easy to promote and comfortable for performers at events.

A.reason_against: Design complexity increases costs and may not be comfortable for performers.

B.reason_against: Costume may be bulky and uncomfortable, which is unacceptable.

C.reason_for: High merchandise compatibility and appealing agile image suitable for children.

D.reason_against: Moderate merchandise compatibility and visibility issues make it less suitable.

personas.name: Zoe
personas.background: Zoe is a graphic designer volunteering to create club merchandise.
personas.private_goal: To pick a mascot that balances community recognition and ease of merchandising.

A.reason_for: Strong image and high merchandise compatibility.
A.reason_against: Design complexity could raise production costs.

B.reason_for: Popular locally with high community recognition and a strong image.

C.reason_for: Appealing to children and high merchandise compatibility.
C.reason_against: Low community recognition requiring extra promotion.

D.reason_against: Moderate merchandise compatibility and color visibility issues.

personas.name: Eli
personas.background: Eli is a community event organizer focused on youth engagement.
personas.private_goal: To choose a mascot that is recognizable and effective at community events.

A.reason_for: Energetic and dynamic image with good merchandise potential.
A.reason_against: Production cost concerns due to design complexity.

B.reason_for: High community recognition and represents resilience well.

C.reason_for: Appeals to younger kids and is merchandise friendly.
C.reason_against: Low community recognition limits event impact.

D.reason_against: Color scheme visibility may be problematic outdoors.

personas.name: Nia
personas.background: Nia is a parent and volunteer focused on youth appeal and fun.
personas.private_goal: To ensure the mascot is fun and attractive to children aged 8-12.

A.reason_for: Strong and exciting image that can energize kids.
A.reason_against: Higher production costs might limit merchandise variety.

B.reason_against: Bulky costume and moderate merchandise compatibility reduce appeal.

C.reason_for: Agile and clever image that resonates well with children and is merchandise friendly.

D.reason_against: Moderate merchandise compatibility and less visible colors.
